lessonTitle: 28. The volume of a right prism
lessonTitleEnglish: The volume of a right prism
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The volume of a right prism is base area times height: V = S(base) · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a right prism is base area times height: V = S(base) · h.

stages.headline: Example: a right triangular prism with base a right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and h = 10 has V = 6 · 10 = 60.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a right triangular prism with base a right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and h = 10 has V = 6 · 10 = 60.

stages.headline: A regular triangular prism has base area a²√3/4, so V = a²√3 · h/4.
stages.headlineEnglish: A regular triangular prism has base area a²√3/4, so V = a²√3 · h/4.
